description: Whether the device's Automox agent is connected: 1 for true, 0 for false. Collected twice a day.

The number of devices the fleet walk collected, and 0 for an organization with no devices. It arrives with every completed walk, so its absence means the device metrics are not current. Collected twice a day.
One series per device with a value of 1, tagged with the device's name, operating system, agent version, and server group. Collected twice a day.
Whether the device is compatible with Automox: 1 for true, 0 for false. Collected twice a day.
Whether the device's last inventory scan failed: 1 for true, 0 for false. Collected twice a day.
Whether Automox manages the device: 0 when the device's policy status is unmanaged, otherwise 1. Collected twice a day.
Whether Automox flags the device as needing attention: 1 for true, 0 for false. Collected twice a day.
Whether the device needs a reboot: 1 for true, 0 for false. Collected twice a day.
The number of outstanding packages on the device that fix a CVE in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. Collected twice a day.
The number of days the device's oldest outstanding package of each severity has waited since Automox first listed it. Collected twice a day.
The number of packages awaiting installation on the device, by severity. Includes every available update, not only the patches Automox considers due. Collected twice a day.
The number of patches Automox considers due on the device. Collected twice a day.
Whether the device's Policy Status is Compliant: 1 when its policies have no scheduled updates or failed remediations, 0 when it is Non-Compliant or Unmanaged. Collected twice a day.
Whether the device's status is ready: 1 for true, 0 while it is installing, working, rebooting, refreshing, or not ready. Collected twice a day.
Whether a device in the Needs Attention report is connected: 1 for true, 0 for false.
The number of non-compliant devices in the Needs Attention report.
Whether a device in the Needs Attention report has been disconnected for 30 days: 1 for true, 0 for false.
One series per device and failing policy in the Needs Attention report with a value of 1, tagged with the policy and its severity.
Whether a device in the Needs Attention report is compatible with Automox: 1 for true, 0 for false.
Whether a device in the Needs Attention report needs a reboot: 1 for true, 0 for false.
The number of outstanding packages on the devices in the Needs Attention report, by severity. Counts packages, not devices.
The number of devices enrolled in the organization.
The organization's licensed device limit. Not reported for a trial or a plan without a limit.
The organization's soft device limit, at which Automox warns rather than blocks.
The number of devices targeted by the policy that are compliant with it.
The number of devices targeted by the policy that are not compliant with it.
The number of devices targeted by the policy whose compliance is pending.
The number of devices in the policy's latest run in the last 24 hours, in any outcome.
The number of devices the policy's latest run in the last 24 hours has failed on.
The number of devices still pending in the policy's latest run in the last 24 hours.
The number of devices the policy's latest run in the last 24 hours has succeeded on.
